facets.description: A negative flusher_processes value is truthy, so it gets through `max_processes or len(...)`. num_processes then goes negative and zero flusher processes are created, so Redis is never flushed and nothing is detected or restarted.
An explicit 0 is falsy, so `max_processes or len(...)` treats it like None (auto mode) and starts one process per shard, not what the user configured.
